payload.outcome: Implemented locally for integration: build:internal invokes scripts/run-next-build.mjs rather than POSIX shell assignment. Real subprocess tests from a path containing spaces verify preserved/default NODE_OPTIONS, 8192 heap, webpack and nonzero exit propagation. RAM/server/upload/service-worker/bundle-secret guards remain. Three focused build/guard/workflow files passed 16 tests; scoped ESLint passed. Full app build and hosted/deployed acceptance were not run; this closes the reported Windows shell syntax defect only after these files land.
